body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 Psychic Damage and make the target Slowed 1 until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: On a hit, the target suffers -1 on its next Success Die until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Strain - Assault
rider.html: If you accepted Strain and hit, suppress one ordinary pain penalty on yourself until your next turn. This does not suppress a Wound Condition.
